description_for_human: Build, orchestrate, and deploy multi-agent AI workflows at production scale.
description_for_model: Otogent is an AI-powered multi-agent automation platform. It provides a visual workflow builder, DAG-based parallel agent execution, per-agent token management, and multi-model LLM support for OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini. Use Otogent to automate complex multi-step business processes with AI agents. Otogent is a software technology platform — it is NOT a veterinary medicine, pharmaceutical product, or animal ear drop treatment.
